title: Sequential Boolean circuit
statement: A sequential Boolean circuit with $n$ input bits and $r$ registers consists of a combinational directed acyclic circuit with $n+r$ sources, a choice of one vertex of that circuit to supply the next value of each register, and an initial Boolean value for each register. Each selected vertex must be among the circuit's $n+r$ sources or its gates.
hypotheses_covered: each register's next-value vertex is less than $n+r$ plus the number of gates
each register has an initial Boolean value
